Devon Cruz: hi all :wave: starting my first week. quick question — if I run into access problems for Dedicated GPU pools or need to escalate a production inference incident, who do I ping? also where do I request infra slack group access? thanks!

Maria Chen: welcome Devon! :tada: For access issues start with the access form (bottom of this thread). For urgent incidents, ping #eng-oncall and @samir. For Dedicated account setup, loop in @alex.

Samir Patel: +1 to Maria. Quick routing: 
- non-urgent access / perms -> fill the access form, tag @maria.
- infra/Dedicated provisioning -> @alex (eng-platform).
- production incidents (latency/errors affecting customers) -> #eng-oncall AND escalate to the on-call via our PagerDuty integration.

Alex Gomez: adding the Dedicated owner flow: when you need a pool or quota bump, open a ticket in the "platform-ops" queue with the label "dedicated-request" and include: model, expected qps, 99th latency target, retention. Example payload:```
{
  "team": "product-name",
  "model": "gptx-7b",
  "qps": 20,
  "p99_target_ms": 200
}
```I'll triage once it's in the queue. If this is blocking deploys, mark it urgent and mention @alex.

Linh Tran: for slack group access you can either:
1) Submit the access form (link below) and add which channels you need, or
2) DM me and I can sponsor you into the infra group (if it's immediate).
Access form: https://redwood.internal/access-request (choose "workspace: infra/eng-platform/dedicated")

eng-oncall-bot: Reminder: Current on-call is Samir Patel (week of 1893350000). To trigger pager duty: escalate in #eng-oncall with `!pager` or use the PagerDuty UI. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/production-latency

Devon Cruz: got it, thanks! one follow-up — what's our expected escalation SLA for production latency incidents? when do I go straight to a P0 vs a P1?

Samir Patel: good Q. TL;DR: 
- P0: total outage or >50% error rate for customer traffic or sustained p99 > 2x SLO for >10 minutes -> immediate P0, call the on-call, page infra leads.
- P1: significant degradation (e.g., p99 1.5-2x SLO or partial region impact) -> notify on-call in #eng-oncall and create incident ticket within 15 minutes.
- P2: degraded non-customer-facing jobs or single-user reports -> file ticket, no page unless it grows.
Full escalation steps: https://redwood.internal/incident-escalation (short checklist in the runbook).

Maria Chen: also on onboarding checklist for you: make sure the "access-request" form is filled (set permissions to "dedicated:read" at minimum), join #eng-oncall read-only for a few days, and we'll schedule a short intro with Platform this week. Ping me if you want me to submit the form for you. :thumbsup:
